evidence.title: Evidence packs
evidence.description: Put every conversation about an order into one document you can attach when a customer disputes a payment.

search.label: Order number
search.empty: No conversation mentions this order. Orders are found when Hay.chat looked them up in your store or a message named them (for example "#1001").
search.emptyConversation: This conversation does not mention an order.
search.emptyCustomer: This customer's conversations do not mention an order.

conversationOnly.title: Use this conversation only
conversationOnly.description: Build the pack from this conversation without an order.

options.title: Build the pack

templates.not_as_described: Item not as described or defective
templates.cancelled_credit: Cancelled order or credit not processed

options.templateHelp: Chooses which store actions and policies the summary puts first. The full conversation is always included.
options.zipHelp: The ZIP adds the attachments, a README and a SHA-256 manifest so anyone can check that no file was changed.
options.imagesOmitted: Some images were too large for the 4 MB PDF limit and were left out of the PDF. They are in the ZIP.
options.overCap: This PDF is larger than 4 MB. Some payment providers do not accept files that large; choose fewer conversations or trim it before uploading.
options.failed: Could not build the evidence pack. Try again.

notes.title: Before you submit
notes.honest: The pack is a record of what Hay.chat stored about these conversations. It does not guarantee any dispute outcome, and each payment provider decides what evidence it accepts.
notes.retention: Your data retention is set to {days} days. Conversations older than that are deleted and cannot be part of a pack. Disputes can be opened months after an order, so a short retention leaves you less evidence.
notes.retentionOff: Conversations are kept until you delete them, so older orders can still be packed.
